text:
Supreme Court, 19 Nov 2026: two orders protect buyers of stalled housing projects from coercive loan recovery.

Sonipat: no recovery until the commercial court checks whether buyers actually defaulted and whether the bank disbursed the loan to the builder as the tripartite agreement required (in stages, linked to construction). Bengaluru: about 4,500 buyers protected till possession.

Why it matters: in subvention and tripartite loans, stage-wise disbursal is the buyer's main safeguard. The court also said such disputes should start in the High Court or NCLT.

Sources: Business Standard, Bar and Bench, PTI. Education only, not legal advice.

When a project stalls, who should carry the risk: the buyer or the bank?
